decisions.option: C (A and B): the clock waits on 'Up next' screens, the break is offered at the part boundary nearest half-way, and each CAT part is capped at its planned share.
decisions.what_changed: (a) SessionClock gets named holds (hold/release by reason: between_parts, break, loading, pause), so overlapping pauses never double-pause or restart a clock another reason still holds; a held reading is computed from the moment of the hold, so it is exact. SessionRun holds the clock from the end of a part (and from Begin) until Start on the next interstitial: Skip on an interstitial and the break offer stay inside the hold. The served 'loading' wait and a taken break hold for reasons of their own. Hard stop, item cap and integrity logs read the same timelines as before (the hard stop cannot fall on a held screen). Every interstitial says 'The clock waits until you press Start.'. (b) From the plan, the boundary between two parts whose planned cumulative time (block E[T], CAT budget_s) is nearest half the target (A15 27.5 min -> before Working Memory in every A15 plan sampled; 20-minute focus sessions use their own half) gets the one break offer, before that part's interstitial; when that part was skipped, the offer comes before the next interstitial shown after it; a one-part plan has no break. The 30-active-minute rule is gone (RunConfig.breakAtS now means the planned second the boundary is chosen nearest to; default target/2). New view fields: breakBefore, clockHeld; RunResult.budgets. (c) A CAT part's budget is min(planned share, (target - elapsed - blocks still to run) / CAT parts left): slow parts still shorten later ones, but a skip or unused time never grows them; the coverage floor (floorRemainingS) is unchanged; the interstitial's 'About N min' shows the capped figure.

strings.before: You have been working for about 30 minutes. You can take a short break now. The clock pauses while you rest.
strings.after: You are about half-way through the planned session. You can take a short break now if you like. The clock waits until you press Start on the next part.
The clock waits until you press Start.

Break: before, offered only in sessions running past 30 active minutes (mean 31.3 min when offered); after, offered in 300/300 sessions, always before Working Memory, mean 13.8 active minutes (9-10 with a skip). decisions.option: B (provisional default, no save-format change): an untouched slider is recorded as not rated (confidence_pct null) and counted in the session flag confidence_untouched_n; the default stays allowed (A not chosen).
decisions.what_changed: Confidence.svelte reports whether the slider was moved (any input event, even back to the start) with onconfirm(pct, touched). SessionRun.confirmConfidence(pct, touched = true): untouched records confidence_pct null in the section-8 tuple (static) and sends confidence null to the server (served; the API and SQL already accept null: p_confidence integer default null, check 0-100 only when not null; responses.confidence nullable), keeps it out of the in-session calibrationSummary/observation (save/rescore.ts already skips null, so the re-score matches), and counts it in flags.confidence_untouched_n (a number; hb.valid_flags and save/validate.ts accept it). UX-111 (slider step) unchanged.
